annotations.title: Get the checkout link for a plan

description: Get the simorago.com checkout page link for one plan, with purchasable (whether checkout is open now). Payment is made by the traveller on simorago.com in a browser; this tool does not buy anything. Use it when someone wants to buy a plan found with search_plans.

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.

plan_id.description: Plan id exactly as returned by search_plans (the id field of a plan).

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get the checkout link for a plan
